abstract: Dysregulated overproduction of interleukin-6 (IL-6) from activated B cells in affected lymph nodes has been implicated in the pathogenesis of multicentric Castleman's disease (MCD), a rare lymphoproliferative disorder accompanied by systemic manifestations. We here report the case of a 32-year-old female presenting with MCD associated with a dermoid cyst in the pelvic cavity. The co-occurrence of MCD and dermoid cyst has not been reported before. Immunohistochemical analysis of the tissue sections showed IL-6 production in CD68-positive macrophage cells, which had infiltrated the dermoid cyst. Removal of the cyst resulted in partial improvement in systemic symptoms accompanied by a decrease in serum IL-6, while complete improvement was obtained by treatment with an anti-IL-6 receptor antibody following resection of the dermoid cyst. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to provide evidence of IL-6 production by CD68(+) cells in a dermoid cyst involved in MCD.
abstract_ja: 多中心性キャッスルマン病(MCD)は、活性化B細胞からのIL-6過剰産生が病態に関与するとされる、全身症状を伴う稀なリンパ増殖性疾患である。今回、骨盤内の類皮嚢腫を合併したMCDの32歳女性例を報告する。両者の合併は過去に報告がない。組織切片の免疫組織化学的解析により、類皮嚢腫に浸潤したCD68陽性マクロファージがIL-6を産生していることが示された。嚢腫摘出後、全身症状と血清IL-6は部分的に改善し、その後、抗IL-6受容体抗体の投与により完全に改善した。われわれの知る限り、類皮嚢腫内のCD68陽性細胞によるIL-6産生をMCDに関与するものとして示した初の報告である。
